title: Finite Group Reduction of the DR/DZ Hierarchies
summary: We show that the finite group reduction of the Dubrovin-Zhang/Double Ramification hierarchy associated with a semisimple CohFT preserves its bihamiltonian structure and its tau structure. By applying this result to the orbifold Gromov-Witten theory with the target $\mathbb{P}^1_{2,2,2,2}$, we obtain two non-equivalent integrable hierarchies which can be associated with the Frobenius manifold structure on the Hurwitz space $M_{1;1}$, and we show that one of them is equivalent to the genus one topological recursion.
